record.bible_text: And God<WH0430> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> all these words<WH01697>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thou shalt not bow down<WH07812><WTH8691> thyself to them, nor serve<WH05647><WTH8714> them: for I the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> <FI>am<Fi> a jealous<WH07067> God<WH0410>, visiting<WH06485><WTH8802> the iniquity<WH05771> of the fathers<WH01> upon the children<WH01121> unto the third<WH08029> and fourth<WH07256> <FI>generation<Fi> of them that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me;
And shewing<WH06213><WTH8802> mercy<WH02617> unto thousands<WH0505> of them that love<WH0157><WTH8802> me, and keep<WH08104><WTH8802> my commandments<WH04687>.

Thou shalt not take<WH05375><WTH8799> the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> in vain<WH07723>; for the LORD<WH03068> will not hold him guiltless<WH05352><WTH8762> that taketh<WH05375><WTH8799> his name<WH08034> in vain<WH07723>.

Six<WH08337> days<WH03117> shalt thou labour<WH05647><WTH8799>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> all thy work<WH04399>:

But the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117> <FI>is<Fi> the sabbath<WH07676> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>: <FI>in it<Fi> thou shalt not do<WH06213><WTH8799> any work<WH04399>, thou, nor thy son<WH01121>, nor thy daughter<WH01323>, thy manservant<WH05650>, nor thy maidservant<WH0519>, nor thy cattle<WH0929>, nor thy stranger<WH01616> that <FI>is<Fi> within thy gates<WH08179>:

For <FI>in<Fi> six<WH08337> days<WH03117> the LORD<WH03068> made<WH06213><WTH8804> heaven<WH08064> and earth<WH0776>, the sea<WH03220>, and all that in them <FI>is<Fi> , and rested<WH05117><WTH8799> the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117>: wherefore the LORD<WH03068> blessed<WH01288><WTH8765> the sabbath<WH07676> day<WH03117>, and hallowed<WH06942><WTH8762> it.<CM>

Honour<WH03513><WTH8761> thy father<WH01> and thy mother<WH0517>: that thy days<WH03117> may be long<WH0748><WTH8686> upon the land<WH0127> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee.
Thou shalt not kill<WH07523><WTH8799>.

Thou shalt not steal<WH01589><WTH8799>.
Thou shalt not bear<WH06030><WTH8799> false<WH08267> witness<WH05707> against thy neighbour<WH07453>.

Thou shalt not covet<WH02530><WTH8799> thy neighbour's<WH07453> house<WH01004>, thou shalt not covet<WH02530><WTH8799> thy neighbour's<WH07453> wife<WH0802>, nor his manservant<WH05650>, nor his maidservant<WH0519>, nor his ox<WH07794>, nor his ass<WH02543>, nor any thing that <FI>is<Fi> thy neighbour's<WH07453>.<CM>

And all the people<WH05971> saw<WH07200><WTH8802> the thunderings<WH06963>, and the lightnings<WH03940>, and the noise<WH06963> of the trumpet<WH07782>, and the mountain<WH02022> smoking<WH06226>: and when the people<WH05971> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , they removed<WH05128><WTH8799>, and stood<WH05975><WTH8799> afar off<WH07350>.

And they said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> thou with us, and we will hear<WH08085><WTH8799>: but let not God<WH0430> speak<WH01696><WTH8762> with us, lest we die<WH04191><WTH8799>.

And the people<WH05971> stood<WH05975><WTH8799> afar off<WH07350>, and Moses<WH04872> drew near<WH05066><WTH8738> unto the thick darkness<WH06205> where God<WH0430> <FI>was<Fi> .<CM>

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Thus thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, Ye have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> that I have talked<WH01696><WTH8765> with you from heaven<WH08064>.
Ye shall not make<WH06213><WTH8799> with me gods<WH0430> of silver<WH03701>, neither shall ye make<WH06213><WTH8799> unto you gods<WH0430> of gold<WH02091>.

An altar<WH04196> of earth<WH0127> thou shalt make<WH06213><WTH8799> unto me, and shalt sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8804> thereon thy burnt offerings<WH05930>, and thy peace offerings<WH08002>, thy sheep<WH06629>, and thine oxen<WH01241>: in all places<WH04725> where I record<WH02142><WTH8686> my name<WH08034> I will come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto thee, and I will bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thee.

And if thou wilt make<WH06213><WTH8799> me an altar<WH04196> of stone<WH068>, thou shalt not build<WH01129><WTH8799> it of hewn stone<WH01496>: for if thou lift up<WH05130><WTH8689> thy tool<WH02719> upon it, thou hast polluted<WH02490><WTH8762> it. <RF>build...: Heb. build them with hewing<Rf>
Neither shalt thou go up<WH05927><WTH8799> by steps<WH04609> unto mine altar<WH04196>, that thy nakedness<WH06172> be not discovered<WH01540><WTH8735> thereon.<CM>
